name: ecommerce-competitor-price-stock-monitor
title: E-Commerce Competitor Price & Stock Monitor (Shopify + JSON-LD + AI Alerts)
description: Asynchronously monitor competitor e-commerce product URLs via Shopify /products/*.json endpoints and Schema.org JSON-LD (Product/Offer). Extracts product name, price, currency, stock availability (IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK), and free shipping conditions, calculates price difference against your baseline price, and generates AI merchandising proposals & Slack alerts with Gemini 2.5 Flash.
